connectDescription: Manage your Meta Portal directly from your browser. No software to install.
step2: Allow USB Debugging on your Portal screen
needsDeviceTitle: Connect a device to use this tool
needsDeviceDescription: Plug your Portal in over USB and connect to start using this tool.
adbAlreadyRunningHint: If you have ADB running, stop it first with:
usbGuideBody: On some Portal models the USB-C port is tucked away on the back. You may need to remove a small cover or flip out the stand to reach it.
wirelessEnableHint: Manage this Portal over Wi-Fi, with no cable. Turn it on here, then install the free bridge app on this computer to reconnect without the cable.
wirelessEnableNote: This restarts the connection in Wi-Fi mode and ends the USB session. You will return to the connect screen, where the next steps are waiting.
wirelessEnabledAt: Wireless enabled. Your Portal is reachable at {{address}}.
wirelessNoIp: Could not read the Portal Wi-Fi address. Make sure it is connected to Wi-Fi.
wirelessConnectSubtitle: No cable. Manage your Portal from across the room, once it is set up.
wirelessStepEnableTitle: Turn on Wi-Fi mode on the Portal
wirelessStepEnableDone: Done. Your Portal is reachable at {{address}}.
wirelessStepEnableTodo: Connect your Portal with the USB cable once, then click Enable wireless ADB on the dashboard.
wirelessWhyUsb: Why is the cable needed first?
wirelessWhyUsbBody: For safety, the Portal only switches to Wi-Fi mode when you ask it over USB. You need the cable just once. After that you can unplug it and connect over Wi-Fi. If the Portal restarts, plug in once to turn it back on. There is no way to skip this first cable step on this device.
wirelessStepBridgeTitle: Install the bridge app on this computer
wirelessStepBridgeDesc: A tiny free app that lets your browser reach the Portal over Wi-Fi. It only passes the connection through and never sees your passwords or keys.
wirelessBridgeChecking: Looking for the bridge on this computer...
wirelessBridgeNotFound: Bridge not found on this computer.
wirelessBridgeInstalledHint: Already installed it? Make sure it is running, then check again.
wirelessConnectBlocked: Finish the steps above to connect without the cable.
